rv.q: HERE COMES J. EDGAR! is a rip-roaringly funny exposé of J. Edgar Hoover, who was Director of the FBI for almost 50 years.
IN THE PRINT fails to emulate the amusing charm and subtlety of last year’s effort.

cn.t: Critics are divided: one praises the clever, hilarious musical exposé of J. Edgar Hoover, while the other finds the 1980s print union drama lacks the charm and subtlety of the writers' previous work.
